description:
[Filings Oracle] One filing by accession number, with its parsed items or insider transactions and the SEC document link.

**Example:** `/v1/filing?accession=0001731122-26-001341`

Use when you have an accession number and want that one filing with parsed items and the SEC link. Not for searching (use filings_search).

Behavior: read-only. Priced via x402 (USDC on Base) or free with WICKEDAPI_API_KEY; with neither, you get HTTP 402 with the decoded price in payment_required (a price quote, not a failure).
name: filings_filing
